verdict.rationale: Lorikeet explicitly states zero-data-retention agreements with all model vendors and no fine-tuning on customer data, directly addressing the story's request to prevent data from being used for AI training. This is backed by independently verified trust/compliance reports on their Vanta Trust Center. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification or third-party audit confirmation of this specific claim, and no detail on user-level opt-out controls or granularity of enforcement.
